## 1stDibs to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conference


10/06/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 68 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/756296962/files/doc_news/1stDibs-to-Participate-in-Upcoming-Investor-Conference-00bf903d6-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


1stdibs.com, Inc. (Nasdaq: DIBS), a leading online marketplace for luxury design products, announced today that CEO David Rosenblatt and CFO Tom Etergino will present at the LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event Conference in Los Angeles on Wednesday, October 21 at 12:30 PM ET.


About 1stDibs
1stDibs is a leading online marketplace for connecting design lovers with highly coveted sellers and makers of vintage, antique, and contemporary furniture, home décor, art, jewelry, watches and fashion.


Investor Relations Contact:
Kevin LaBuz, Head of Investor Relations & Corporate Development
investors@1stDibs.com
